browser: Chrome 154.0.0.0 on macOS; same existing logged-in session and network
readiness: navigation start to #chat-input visible with isContentEditable; final actual insertion/undo verified
cold: DevTools Page.reload(ignoreCache=true); no cookie or localStorage clearing
